prompt: Order the body of `vec_push`. When the vector is full it grows with `realloc` (4 first, then doubling) without losing the old data if memory runs out. One line does not belong.
explain: Ask `realloc` through a temporary pointer. Only if it succeeds do you store the new pointer and capacity. Assigning the result directly to `v->data` would lose the original block when `realloc` returns `NULL`.
